facts.fact: Liberia's Electronic Transactions Law (Chapter 13, Title 14, General Business Law) was approved 8 January 2002 and published 19 June 2002, taking effect on publication in handbills; it gives electronic records, contracts and signatures legal effect, and applies at once to matters under Titles 5 and 21 but elsewhere only as regulations of the Minister of Foreign Affairs bring it into effect.

systems.owner: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Recognition Authority for certification authorities)

note: No reach fact: the document gives the Minister power to make regulations and a Recognition Authority power to recognize certification authorities, but states no regulation made and no recognition granted.
